info.name: 360learning Subscriptions API
info.description: Operations tagged Subscriptions across 2 of this provider's published API definitions: 360learning-bulk-api.json, 360learning-webhook-api.json. Each path carries the servers of the definition it was published in.

request.description:
> 🔑
>
> Required OAuth scope: `subscriptions:bulk`.

> 🚜
>
> This endpoint processes up to 20,000 objects asynchronously. For more information, see the Bulk operations guide.

Creates multiple email subscription events. Upon submission, the request is queued. Use the provided URL in the response header to check the status of the bulk operation.

response.name: The operation is successfully created.

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: oauth2

description.content:
The URL to retrieve the status of the bulk operation using its operation ID.

Example: `https://app.360learning.com/api/v2/bulk/operations/507f1f77bcf86cd799439011`.

item.name: Retry the failed webhook events of a webhook subscription

variable.description: (Required) The unique ID of the webhook subscription.

request.description:
> 🔑
>
> Required OAuth scope: `webhooks:write`.

Retries all failed webhook events for a subscription within the specified timeframe (maximum 3 days per request). Events are retained for 90 days and can be retried in multiple requests.

response.name: Retries the failed webhook events for the given webhook subscription and the given timeframe.

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: oauth2

item.name: Rotate the signing secret of a webhook subscription

variable.description: (Required) The unique ID of the webhook subscription.

request.description:
> 🔑
>
> Required OAuth scope: `webhookSecrets:write`.

Rotates the signing secret for the given webhook subscription. In addition to the new signature, the events will also be signed with the legacy secret for 24 hours.

response.name: Returns the new signing secret of the webhook subscription.
